destiny.story.reason/1: One day, you had enough and decided on a journey to explore the world.
destiny.story.travelling/1: You conquered snowy mountains and muggy swamps, Avoiding Husks in the endless deserts.
destiny.story.somewhere/1: You are stranded without food and shelter in the middle of nowhere.
destiny.story.sailing/1: You spent the few emeralds you had saved to board a small ship. But a storm decided the fate of the vessel and it's crew, destroying and tearing it apart.
destiny.story.shipwreck_beached/1: You wake up in the debris of a stranded ship, far from anything you know, the crew dead or missing.
destiny.story.village_desert/1: One day, you came across a small village in the middle of a desert. The water is scarce and the sun, glaring against your eyes, but the villagers seems satisfied with their life

destiny.story.village_snowy/1: You fight your way through a heavy snowstorm when you see dim lights up ahead. It is a village, maybe they have an inn to warm up?
destiny.story.village_plains/1: In the middle of a plains biome, a few villagers built themselves a settlement. The climate is moderate, the people friendly, perhaps they have place for another settler?
destiny.story.village_savanna/1: Finally you find a village between dry trees and grass. Let's see if they are friendly!
destiny.story.ancient_city/1: But an unfortunate misstep sends you tumbling into a deep, dark cave. When you regain consciousness, you find yourself surrounded by the ancient ruins of a city forgotten by the world for eons.

settlements.book.how.title: How the village lives
settlements.book.how.1: Everything the villagers gather goes to the town hall's stores. The lumberjack fells and replants trees, the miner digs stone and ore, the farmer, herdsman and fisher feed the village.
settlements.book.how.2: The builder takes from the stores and raises houses and workshops by plan. Short of materials, he gathers them himself or asks for help. More people and buildings mean a higher village level.
settlements.book.how.3: You can help: hand what's needed to a villager, trade, defend us from enemies. Help is remembered, and so are theft and violence. News and needs are on the notice board.
